name: type-repeater
title: Type Repeater
description: An After Effects style repeater on a word, where copies unfold into a tunnel, a spiral or a fan behind it, breathe, then fold back into the word.
useWhen: One word should hit hard for a beat, with repetition giving it depth and energy around a still, readable center.
A motion-graphics flourish is wanted for a title card, a section break or a loop.
A single word needs a backdrop made from itself, in the word's color stepping to an accent.
avoidWhen: The repeats should stack in a quiet vertical column above and below the word: use echo-stack.
The whole frame should fill with scrolling rows of the word: use type-wall.
The word should be carried by a spinning 3D band: use ring-text.
author: Remocn
